info.title: Budget Tracker API
info.description: Backend API for expense tracking, budgeting, forecasting (ML via external engine), alerts, and scenario (what-if) simulation. Designed for mobile-first clients and extensible domain growth.

get.summary: Daily aggregates for a date range

post.description: Server builds time series from stored aggregates and calls external ML engine. In MVP external engine may be stubbed.
Scenarios describe planned changes (e.g., recurring payment, % cut by category). Server may run forecast for scenario and link result to a forecast run.
Reserved for future import flows: CSV, bank exports, OSDU-like integrations.
Optional callback endpoint if forecast engine runs asynchronously and pushes results.

requestId.description: Correlation id. Server echoes it back (or generates one).

idempotencyKey.description: Idempotency key for safe retries of POST. Same key -> same result.

location.description: URL to poll async resource status.

requestIdHeader.name: X-Request-Id
requestIdHeader.description: Optional correlation id from client. Helps to trace logs end-to-end.

idempotencyKeyHeader.name: Idempotency-Key
idempotencyKeyHeader.description: Recommended for POST requests. Allows safe retries without duplicates.

message.example: Validation failed: amount must be positive

historyDays.description: How many days of history to use

date.description: Optional date the alert relates to

message.example: Risk of exceeding monthly budget (p90) by 12%.

parameters.description: Scenario payload; shape depends on type

runForecast.description: If true, server runs forecast for this scenario
